paite: Tiberias Kaisar vaihawm akum sawm-le-nga kum in, Judia gam ukpa Pontias Pilat ahi a, Galili gam kumpipa Herod ahi a, a-unau Philip, Ituria leh Trakoniti gam kumpipa ahi a, Abilin gam kumpipa Lusania ahi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Leh Athupuak / (Mat 3.1-12; Mar 1.1-8; Joh 1.19-28)

paite: Annas leh Kaiapha siampu lianpen ahi ua, huai lai in gamdai ah Zakariah tapa Johan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
Amah bel Jordan lui gei kim gam tengteng ah ahoh a, thil hihkhial ngaihdamna ding in kisikna baptisma thu agen zel hi.
Zawlnei Isai laibu a: "Gamdai a kikou aw in, Toupa lampi sial unla, alampite tangsak un.
Guam chih sundim ahi ding a, tang leh mual chih, hihniam ahi ding; lampi kawite tansak ahi ding a, lampi phokte mamsak ahi ding.
Huan mi tengteng in Pathian hotdamna amu ding uh," achi, chih gelh bang in.
Ama'n baptisma tang ding akiang a mipi hong sukte kiang ah, "Nou gul suante aw, thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon vauhilh ahia?
Huchi in kisik minputak in gah un, ei hon suangpa Abraham ahi na lungsim un chi kei un; Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei chih ka hon hilh ahi.
Tu mahmah in singbul teng ah heipi koih ahita; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhmah phuk in a-om a, mei ah paih in a-om," achi hi.
Huan mipite'n akiang ah, "Bang ka hihta ding ua?" chi in adong uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuapeuh puanak nih nei in anei lou kiang ah hawm hen; kuapeuh an nei in huchibang mah in hih hen," chi in adawng hi.
Huan siahkhon mite leng baptisma tang ding in ahong ua, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, bang ka hih ding ua?" achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon sehsak val uh khon kei un," achi hi.
Sepaihte'n leng akiang ah, "Kou leng bang ka hih ding ua?" chi in adong uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuamah hiamgam in hih kei unla, dikloupi in kuamah hek kei unla, na loh uah lungkim un," achi hi.
Huan mite'n alamet ua, mi tengteng in Johan tungthu alungtang ua, Khrist ahi kha zenzen diam aw? chi a angaihtuah lai un,

Johan in adawng a, avek ua kiang ah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh kei sang a mithupizaw ahong pai ding, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei; ama'n Kha Siangthou leh mei in nou ahon baptis ding.
Akhut in aphazah atawi a, aphual zapsianna ding leh buhpang a buhte sunlutna ding in; asite mei mit ngei lou ah ahalmang ding," achi hi.
Huan hanthawnna tampi in mite kiang ah tanchinhoih ahilh zel hi.
Himahleh kumpipa Herod in anaupa zi, Herodias tungthu ah leh athilhihkhelh tung a Johan in ataihilh ziak in,
athilhihkhelh tengteng behlap in amah suangkul ah akhum hi.
Huan mi tengteng abaptis zoh in, hichi ahong hi a, Jesu leng baptis zoh a a-om in, athum a, van ahong kihong a,
heading: Jesu Baptisna / (Mat 3.13-17; Mar 1.9-11)

paite: Kha Siangthou sa pu in vakhu bang in ahong suk a, atung ah atuta a; van a kipan in aw ahong pawt a, "Nang ka Tapa deihtak na hi; na tung ah ka kipak mahmah," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n thu ahilh pat tung lai in amah kum sawmthum vel ahita, mi ngaih in zaw Joseph tapa ahi a, huai Heli tapa ahi a,
heading: Jesu Khangsutna / (Mat 1.1-17)
